_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that extend and significantly improve their lives through the discovery, development and manufacture of healthcare products' (FY2017 10-K, Item 1); 'Competition from manufacturers of generic drugs is a major challenge for our branded products around the world, and the loss or expiration of intellectual property rights can have a significant adverse effect on our revenues' (Item 1A); 'A number of our products are expected to face significantly increased generic competition over the next few years' (Item 1A); 'Our businesses are conducted in intensely competitive and often highly regulated markets'

classification.quality_note: 'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that extend and significantly improve their lives through the discovery, development and manufacture of healthcare products' (FY2017 10-K, Item 1); 'Competition from manufacturers of generic drugs is a major challenge for our branded products around the world, and the loss or expiration of intellectual property rights can have a significant adverse effect on our revenues' (Item 1A); 'A number of our products are expected to face significantly increased generic competition over the next few years' (Item 1A); 'Our businesses are conducted in intensely competitive and often highly regulated markets'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 10.39x; +34% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.52; conservative 2yr -10%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -47.2%/yr (worst year FY08-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (FY19 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +4.7%/yr (FY08-FY18 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +78.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY18); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PFE (retrospective, 2019-02-15) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 10.39x (88.2% downside to Bear $5 / +8.5% upside to Bull $46) | Adj composite 2.17 vs market 2.69: gap -0.52 [OVERVALUED] | +34% above the EPP floor $32 (17x FY19E $1.86) | Conservative 2-yr case: -9.7% total (-4.8%/yr) | At 22.8x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $56 sits above the BULL case; U.S. revenues -0.6% in Q4 2018, forward revenues -3.1% to +0.7% (FY19 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
